text:
julia (FinOps): Flagging a billing mismatch for Spectral Health INV-2029-078. Platform fee shows as full year but contract amendment indicates private deploy effective 2029-08-15. Need corrected invoice before next renewal outreach.
omar (Billing): can you share the invoice lines?
julia (FinOps): PDF snippet: INV-2029-078
Line A: Platform Fee - 01Jan2029-31Dec2029 - $84,000
Line B: Migration addendum - Amount: $0
Line C: Support Tier: Enterprise - 15Aug2029-14Aug2030 - $18,000
julia (FinOps): Contract: RDW-SPH-2027-B, Amendment AMEND-88 signed 2029-08-10.
tess (CS): Confirmed customer went live on 15Aug. Sales agreed proration for platform fee to reflect Aug-Dec portion only.
liam (Sales): Sales ops ticket SO-4472 requested proration in July but billing didn't apply. I approve manual adjustment up to $50k.
omar (Billing): Reproduced: renewals job misses amendments with mid-month effective dates when using day-based pro-rate. Creating billing-engine ticket BE-8124.
billing-bot: New issue BE-8124 created: "renewals proration skips mid-month amendments" assigned billing-engine-team.
julia (FinOps): We need a manual credit now. Pro-rate approach: month-based pro-rate -> Aug-Dec = 5 months, credit = 84,000 * 5/12 = 35,000? wait that's the due portion; compute credit = 84,000 - (84,000 * 5/12) = 49,000. Please show calculation and reference AMEND-88.
omar (Billing): I'll draft credit memo for $49,000 and corrected invoice reflecting platform fee for Aug-Dec = $35,000. Will attach AMEND-88 and SO-4472 and route for approval AR-7903. ETA draft by EOD.
tess (CS): I'll tell the customer we're issuing a corrected invoice and include the amendment PDF for their records.
liam (Sales): Thumbs up. Please include my approval in AR-7903.
billing-bot: BE-8124 update: triage complete; fix in progress; backfill planned for nightly run.
julia (FinOps): Thanks. Once credit posts, I'll reconcile revenue and update renewal timeline. Pls ping when BE-8124 backfill finishes so we can verify automation catches previous misses.
